name: budget-guard
description: Stops an agent run at 75% of the five-hour usage window and reports sprint usage against the 30% weekly cap, reading the five-hour percentage from the best available source and saying so when no reading is available instead of guessing.
inputs: For check: an optional status-line JSON file, the newest manual reading stored with `reading`, and optionally session transcript JSONL files; the five-hour calibration lines in the eds-data ledger when transcripts are used. For sprint: a sprint name and the effort events in the ledger.
outputs: JSON on stdout. check: verdict (ok, stop, unverified or unavailable), five_hour_pct, source, confidence, lower_bound, the sources tried with the reason each was or was not used, flags and a one-line message; exit 0 ok, 3 stop, 4 unavailable or unverified. sprint: per-role and unassigned percent, the total against the cap, share of cap and a verdict (ok, over_cap or unavailable). reading: the stored reading. Readings are appended to readings.jsonl in a local state directory (default ~/.eds/budget-guard, override with EDS_BUDGET_STATE_DIR) outside every repo.
dependencies: ledger-append skill (reads calibration and effort events from the eds-data ledger)
Five-hour calibration lines in the eds-data ledger (only for transcript-based sources)
